The two chefs are cooking for judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton, and guest judge Lady Claire MacDonald OBE. There are standout dishes from both chefs making it a difficult contest to judge.

Three of the finest chefs from Wales are competing to be crowned champion. Two chefs are back for a second time: Phil Carmichael, from Cowbridge, South Wales, is executive chef at Berners Tavern in London, and Adam Bannister is chef and co-owner of Slice in his home city of Swansea. Adam was crowned Welsh champion last year so this year Phil is back with something to prove. He plans to go home raising the flag for Wales. The third chef is newcomer Andrew Birch, also from Swansea.

It is the fish course and newcomer Andrew Birch is confident - he is passionate about seafood. He is celebrating the cockle, which is harvested near his home city of Swansea. Adam Bannister has created an alter ego, Captain Bannister, for his modern take on the old boil-in-the-bag fish dinner, and Phil has chosen to revamp the classic prawn cocktail.

Phil Carmichael is serving up his version of an OBE, a refined take on onions, bacon and egg. Adam is planning to serve up wild boar on a spit, while Andrew turns up the heat when he combines strong Japanese flavours with a traditional roast.

It is the dessert course and one chef will go home. Phil Carmichael is determined it won't be him but not everything is going to plan when he tackles his "Cup of Tea for Ma'am". One of the accompaniments to his Earl Grey panna cotta just won't work. He has to make a difficult decision.

It is the head to head. The two highest scoring chefs from Wales are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort who are joined by guest judge, blogger and food writer Rosie Birkett.

Three newcomers are competing to become regional champion. Daniel Smith, a former head chef for the Roux brothers, now runs his own restaurant in his beloved home county of Norfolk. Andrew Scott's worked with the best in the business, and he's concentrating on telling powerful stories as well as delivering perfect flavours. Danny Gill is a former head chef at Daniel Clifford's two-star restaurant Midsummer House.

It is the fish course and the chefs are using some of the UK's best seafood: lobster, salmon and Cornish crab. Danny Gill is a chef who likes to use the very latest equipment to create the most intense flavours. He's going to great lengths to maximise the taste of his cucumber consommé, and it is causing a lot of interest in the kitchen.

Two chefs are cooking venison. Danny Gill is making a venison wellington, inspired by his Dad, a former RAF chef who has served up wellington for royalty at many air force banquets, while Andrew Scott has sourced his venison from the Queen's Scottish estate, Balmoral.

This week three chefs from the central region are fighting to be crowned champion. One competitor will go home, only the two highest scoring chefs will make it through to the judging chamber. Danny Gill is facing his toughest day yet, choosing to make a staggering eight elements for his imaginative dessert.

The Central region's two highest scoring chefs are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort, for the very first time. Joining them in the chamber is guest judge Enam Ali MBE, a food entrepreneur who set up The British Curry Awards.

Three of the most exciting talents from London and the South East region are competing for a place in the national finals. Head chef Mark Froydenlund runs Marcus Wareing's two-star restaurant. Russell Bateman is head chef at The Grove in Hertfordshire and Ronnie Murray who heads up the Hix Restaurant group.

A look at how religion has served as a reliable tool to brandish political power over thousands of years and been the catalyst for war, conflict, and persecution, from the Crusades to witch hunts.

In the battle between truth and lies, money has often played a decisive role, from Julius Caesar to the Koch brothers, and nothing seems to be safe from its power and the influence of those who possess wealth.

Scandals have accompanied human history since ancient times, and every lie comes with the risk of being exposed and creating a scandal big enough to send shock waves through a society and trigger social upheaval.

Conspiracy theories feed on basic human impulses like fear and insecurity. From Mozart to JFK and QAnon to COVID-19, conspiracies emerge from anywhere at any time and spread by all means available, with the potential for danger and destruction.

pr.t: Home Rescue - Wohnen in der Wildnis
pr.d: Marty, Matt und Misty sind bei einem Bauernhof in den Appalachen in West Virginia zu Besuch, auf dem mehr als 300 Tiere leben. Das Problem liegt jedoch darin, dass der Hof am Berg liegt, während die Trinkwasserquelle sich im Tal befindet.

pr.t: Home Rescue - Wohnen in der Wildnis
pr.d: Kristin und Sky Solbach leben auf der hawaiianischen Insel Maui. Tief im tropischen Dschungel wollen die Aussteiger ein selbstbestimmtes Leben führen. Doch gerade braut sich im Paradies ein heftiges Gewitter zusammen. Denn in der fünf Monate dauernden Regenzeit können sich Bäche und Flüsse schnell in reißende Ströme verwandeln. Das Grundstück war bereits mehrfach überflutet. Marty, Matt und Misty Raney sind zur Stelle, um die Solbachs im wahrsten Sinne des Wortes vor dem Untergang zu bewahren.

Vincent und seine Frau sind auf der Suche nach einer Immobilie, in die sie sich zurückziehen und sich von ihrem Alltag entspannen können. Sie werden am Desert Pond fündig. Chase Morill und sein Team helfen ihnen, die Immobilie herzurichten.

Eine Familie aus Maine hat ein großes Problem mit ihrer Immobilie aus den 70er Jahren. Denn damals wurde beim Anstrich von Häusern oft bleihaltige Farbe verwendet und es hat sich herausgestellt, dass diese gesundheitsgefährdend ist.

Jenna und Guillaume wollen keine Wurzeln schlagen. Die Mittzwanziger wollen ganz Amerika mit einem Abenteuerhaus auf Rädern erkunden. Sie haben sich verschiedene Optionen angesehen und entschieden, ihr winziges Haus ohne Fertigelemente zu bauen.

Derek und Mary arbeiten beim Militär und sind Fans von Minihäusern. Sie haben beschlossen, einen Bauunternehmer mit der Grobarbeit zu beauftragen. Zwar packen sie gelegentlich mit an, überlassen aber lieber dem Profi die Aufgabe.

Die freiberuflichen Set-Designer Chloe und Brandon ziehen von Stadt zu Stadt, um an unterschiedlichen Filmsets zu arbeiten. Sie wünschen sich aber ein festes Zuhause und haben jetzt die scheinbar perfekte Lösung gefunden: ein Minihaus auf Rädern.

Die Studentin Kaitlin ist zu dem Schluss gekommen, dass ihr die Miete für ihr Apartment über den Kopf wächst. Deshalb interessiert sie sich für ein Minihaus. Als ihr Vater Mike davon hört, bietet er ihr seine Baufähigkeiten an.

Die Naturliebhaber Justin und Emily wollen sich nicht mehr mit der Instandhaltung eines großen Hauses belasten. Sie heuern den Minihaus-Experten Jim an, um ihnen ihr eigenes Minihaus aus Birke zu bauen, in dem sie mit ihrem Kleinkind und ihren fünf Haustieren unterkommen können. Jims Design enthält alle Notwendigkeiten auf 30 Quadratmetern.

Emily hat sich immer gewünscht, dass ihre Kinder einmal im Ausland leben. Jetzt wird dieser Wunsch endlich wahr. Da ihr Mann vorerst in den USA bleiben wird, begleitet ihr Sohn sie bei der Suche nach einem Zuhause im Senegal.

Troy und Brandy möchten ihrem Sohn Lincoln eine Ausbildung im Ausland ermöglichen. Dann erhält Lincoln ein unausschlagbares Angebot für eine Fußball-Profikarriere in Luxemburg. Mit großen Erwartungen starten sie die Haussuche.

Der Elektrotechniker Glen und die Zumba-Lehrerin Teri ziehen nach Medellín in Kolumbien. Allerdings stellen ihre gegensätzlichen Vorstellungen von ihrem zukünftigen Zuhause den Immobilienmakler vor eine große Herausforderung.

A house with a bathroom layout challenge in Ripley, Derbyshire, a huge three-storey house with its freehold on offer in Erdington, Birmingham, and a mid-terrace house in London's East Ham in need of a major makeover are all sold under the hammer.

Dion Dublin is in Lincolnshire looking round a pair of rural semi-detached cottages which the new owner may convert into one home. Martin Roberts is in Cheshire at a bungalow with bags of potential, and Lucy Alexander is in Kent talking to friends embarking on their first project together.

A house in Chesterton in Staffordshire has a smelly problem and needs a total overhaul. The new owner of a semi in Bestwood in Nottingham also has a lot to do, while the new owner of a flat in Strawberry Hill has less than a week to sort out her auction buy before she jets off to Germany.

A husband-and-wife duo add their design skills to a house in Croydon, while a seasoned developer creates a high-end house of multiple occupation in Coventry. Also, a first-time developer also does a great job with a house full of period features.

Martin Roberts meets one of two young brothers busy building a property portfolio in Bolsover, Derbyshire, while Dion Dublin checks out a three-bedroom semi in Wolverhampton, and Lucy Alexander is impressed by plans to convert a two-bedroom, fire-damaged terraced house in London's Plaistow into a smart five-bedroom property.

Dion Dublin has a hair-raising experience at a barber's in Rochdale, Lancashire, while Martin Roberts looks round a great bungalow in Alsager, Cheshire, and Lucy Alexander sees all the potential in a piece of land in Eccles in Kent.

pr.d: Miss Rabbit arrives with the broken Party Bus; this is a job for Grampy Rabbit.
While Mummy and Daddy Pig attend a refresher antenatal class, Peppa and George join Miss Rabbit's Sibling School where they learn about what to expect when their new sibling arrives.
Mummy Pig is confirming she is having a new baby. Mummy and Daddy Pig share the exciting news with Peppa and her brother, George.
Peppa and her friends from playgroup visit a science museum, where they learn all sorts of things.
Peppa and George visit a restaurant for the first time to celebrate Grandpa's birthday. They have a great time asking for everything they would expect at a party.
It is bedtime and Peppa calls Kylie Kangaroo and is surprised to learn that it is not morning or winter where she is! Daddy Pig explains this using a big ball to represent the Earth.
Peppa and family help make a garden on the roof of the flats. Mr Bull assists with a big truck and crane. There is even a little something for Mrs Duck.
The nurse visits and decides to focus on teaching proper baby-holding techniques. She demonstrates a safe method for a small person, like Peppa, to hold an infant correctly.
The playgroup is visiting the zoo today. Mr Lion then shows them a giant lizard. The children all believe it's a dinosaur. Mr Lion says if he did have a dinosaur, he would keep that a secret.
Peppa and her family have a day out at the seaside, and build a very large sandcastle with all their friends.

Peppa and George go bird watching with Grandpa Pig. Peppa quacks like a duck, George coos like a pigeon, and they all have great fun filling in Grandpa Pig's book. Grandpa wants to see a cuckoo, and suddenly he hears one calling.
Peppa and her family go to the water park for an adventure, and Miss Rabbit is in charge. There are lots of fun things to do at the water park, but the first thing to do is to put on a swimsuit.
The children must walk to school in a walking bus. Miss Rabbit wears a high visibility jacket, leading Peppa and friends in a bus formation.
Peppa receives an invitation to Candy Cat's birthday party, but a double-decker party bus arrives; the bus goes to the playground and even the beach, hosting the best party ever.
George is being potty-trained and Mummy Pig is encouraging him to shout "potty" whenever he needs the toilet.
It's the day of Penny Polar Bear's party and the children find out they will be playing ice hockey! They are kitted out in safety gear at the ice rink and have great fun learning to play.
Peppa and George wake up in Granny and Grandpa's motorbike tent by the sea. Peppa finds a message in a bottle with a telephone number on it.
Peppa's Playgroup has a garden outside. The children are all having fun growing different plants and playing hide and seek in the wild wood.
Madame Gazelle is giving the playgroup a singing lesson. When the parents arrive, the children perform their song. Madame Gazelle reveals that tomorrow there will be a singing competition.
Mr Meerkat shows the children a huge wall that needs painting. They create a fantastic mural using lots of different techniques: brushes, sponges, buggy ropes and even a paint cannon!

Peppa and family are on the search for a new home but after all the house viewings, nothing beats their home. Peppa then suggests they extend their house instead, so the family design a bigger house together.

Peppa and friends are at school where they have a special guest, Mr Potato. Together they sing the vegetable song about the importance of eating five fruits or vegetables a day. Mr Potato is there to host a special quiz about fruit and vegetables. They argue about a tomato being a vegetable and have to call up a very clever friend to help. Two groups of children compete to find out who knows the most.
pr.sub: Mr. Potato's Fruit and Vegetable Quiz

pr.d: Miss Rabbit's Rescue Service has saved many people from tricky situations, but what happens when Miss Rabbit needs rescuing herself.
The Pig family go to the hospital, where Peppa is determined to find the perfect name for the baby.

Mummy Pig and Peppa are at the zoo and meet Lorenzo Lion who lives there; he is helping his daddy, Mr. Lion the zookeeper, take care of the zoo; Lorenzo shows Peppa his toy zoo, but he keeps misplacing his wooden animals in his two bedrooms!

At the gym, Madame Gazelle is teaching the children about martial arts. Along with Mr. Bull, the children learn how to fall safely, balance and even how to throw punches in the right stance. Mr. Bull gives them their white belts.
Grandpa Pig is taking Peppa and George for a day on his boat. They meet Mr Bull who is using his digger boat to remove all the rubbish in the river that shouldn't be there.
pr.sub: Mr Bull Digs Up the River

pr.d: Peppa and her family take Goldie the Fish to Doctor Hamster for her check-up. They see Grampy Rabbit and his pet newt. Doctor Hamster tells Grampy Rabbit about how she wishes she could exercise more but doesn't have any room. Grampy Rabbit decides to build something special to help Dr Hamster exercise more.
Peppa, George and Freddy Fox are mistaken for pirates while sailing on the river with Grandpa Pig. When the truth is revealed, officers Panda and Squirrel invite them for a ride in their police boat.
During a picnic in her garden, cousin Chloe shows Peppa and George fun things to do with flowers.
Auntie, Uncle Pig, and cousin Chloe are coming for dinner and Peppa is allowed to join too! Peppa is very proud of staying up late; she even stayed up later than the Daddies!
After finding out Daddy Pig has a place in the London Marathon, Peppa and George help Daddy Pig become stronger with lots of different, though not all typical, exercises.
The children's favourite teacher, Madame Gazelle, is leaving Playgroup. They are very sad to be losing her, but decide to throw a leaving party to give her a good send-off.
Peppa and George explore the greenhouse, and it is full of lovely tomatoes and basil. When it is time for dinner, Granny Pig takes all the ingredients they have grown and makes a tasty salad.

Daddy Pig receives a letter saying he must go away on business to test some very important concrete. Peppa, Mummy and George all decide to go with Daddy and enjoy a train journey, where they sing to pass the time.
After smelling Granny Pig's perfume de lavender, Peppa experiments with the flowers in the garden to create her own special smell.
Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy enjoy flying a kite in the park until their kite gets tangled in a tree beside a big, muddy puddle.

George joins Peppa at her playgroup today. Peppa doesn't really want George to be there. It's her playgroup after all. Then George is an instant hit with all of Peppa's friends. They think he's 'brilliant'.
Peppa brings home a teddy from playgroup to look after, but she is worried that he will not have a very exciting time.
Miss Rabbit gives Mummy Pig, Peppa and George a ride in her rescue helicopter. Daddy Pig is very sad to miss all the fun, but Miss Rabbit makes sure that doesn't happen.
Peppa and George are excited when Mr Zebra delivers a package from Aunt Dottie, who lives abroad, but they have different ideas about what they want to name their new toy.
Peppa's playgroup is holding a jumble sale to raise money for a new roof and Madame Gazelle asks everyone to bring something to sell. Peppa and each of her friends bring in an old toy.
On a beautiful sunny day, Grandpa takes Peppa and George to spend the day sailing. After an accident, the boat ends up sinking, and now they need rescuing with a hovercraft.
Goldie the Goldfish is feeling a little lonely, so Peppa takes her to the aquarium. With all the different fish there, Peppa must find a new friend for Goldie.
Madame Gazelle takes the class to London for the day, where they are given a tour of the city by none other than the Queen of England.
Madame Gazelle takes Peppa and her school friends on a school bus trip to the mountains. From the top of the mountains, there is a fantastic view, and Peppa and her friends have fun hearing echoes.
Playgroup is having a pet competition and everyone has brought their pets. Dr Hamster is the judge, but it is so hard to choose the best pet.
Peppa and her friends are playing pirates, but when they put together a treasure chest and bury it in a marked spot, Pedro soon realises that he needs to follow the trail. He's lost something.

Arnold lädt Lila zum alljährlichen Käsefest ein, weil er für sie schwärmt. Helga ist eifersüchtig und versucht, das Rendezvous zu stören. Harold findet sich selbst zu dick und fährt auf eine Kreuzfahrt. Dort werden spezielle Kinder-Diäten angeboten.
pr.sub: Das Käsefest; Schlank um jeden Preis

pr.d: The family prepares for war, AKA a trip to the local Asian market. After their battle to procure a rare cookie, Jack feels more part of the family. The Groom & Board gets a bad review. Lily tries to find the culprit and corr.

Helga wird von einem Modemacher entdeckt und ist nun das neue Model für Kindermode. Doch ihr gefällt der Job nicht mehr, da er zu stressig ist. Arnolds Freunde haben genug von seinen Ratschlägen und beschließen, nicht mehr zu machen, was er sagt.

Lil's favourite boba shop is closing! The kids try to save the café using pucker limes, but are quickly forced to save Canyon Valley from the pucker. Lil and Min both realize how similar they are to their mums and set out to distinguish themselves.
pr.sub: The Boba--Get; Be Your Own Bean

pr.d: Big Bob und Opa geraten in einen Verkehrsunfall und beschuldigen sich gegenseitig. Ein Golfspiel soll entscheiden, wer die Reparatur bezahlen muss. Rhonda und Patty haben einen Streit in der Schule. Rhonda soll lernen, wie man sich richtig benimmt.
Alvin dresses Theodore up like a baby in order to impress the girl of his dreams. / While attempting to make a special present for Dave, Alvin creates a snowball effect of chaos.
pr.sub: Baby Whisperer / Let's Make A Deal

pr.d: Arnold und Gerald besuchen eine Veteranengedenkstätte. Opa und Geralds Vater erzählen unglaubliche Geschichten vom Krieg und was sie für Heldentaten vollbracht haben. Doch die Jungs haben Zweifel, ob die Erzählungen wirklich wahr sind.

Simon creates a Super Hero costume for a convention he's attending. But when Alvin wants to join, the two fight over who the real hero is. When Alvin's bicycle is stolen, he joins forces with Officer Dangus to solve the case.

Opa ist enttäuscht, weil er Arnold mit einer Matheaufgabe nicht helfen kann, da er nie die Schule beendet hat. Daraufhin beschließt er, seinen Schulabschluss nachzuholen. Die Kinder bekommen die Aufgabe, auf ein Ei aufzupassen. Dies endet im Chaos.
pr.sub: Das Abschluss-Zeugnis; Die Sache mit dem Ei

pr.d: Max finally declares his independence from his parents' house rules and moves to his friend's house, where they only rule is that there are no rules. However, ultimate freedom quickly becomes more than Max can handle.

Cousin Arnie kommt zu Besuch, doch Arnold findet ihn sehr seltsam, da eines seiner Hobbys ist, Lebensmittelpackungen auf ihre Inhaltsstoffe zu prüfen. Lila ist die Einzige, die ihn wirklich mag. Susie bekommt Besuch von ihrer Cousine Nancy.

Nearing their 100th save, Phoebe and Max are determined to make it their best and most memorable one yet. But by ignoring a series of small saves they overlook a super villain plotting revenge on his old rivals, Hank and Barb.

Helga beginnt zu schlafwandeln und ist immer auf dem Weg zu Arnolds Pension. Arnold und seine Familie nehmen an der TV-Show "Familienkämpfe" teil. Doch seine Familie blamiert ihn vor laufender Kamera und dann geraten sie auch noch in einen Streit.
Schwoz creates a disease that accidentally infects Charlotte, Henry, his family and even Ray. He quarantines them in Henry's house while he tries to find a cure.

Der Monkeymann hat Arnold vor einem schlimmen Unfall bewahrt, dafür will er sich bei ihm bedanken. Doch wo der Superheld steckt, weiß niemand so richtig. Außerdem macht Mr. Simmons einen Klassenausflug in die Schokoladenfabrik.
When Miss Shapen's niece comes into town and chooses Jasper over Henry, he discovers that she has much bigger plans in the works.

Opas Schwester meldet sich nach 70 Jahren und möchte Arnold kennenlernen. Doch der Besuch verläuft schwierig. Trainer Wittenbergs Karriere neigt sich dem Ende zu, doch Arnold hilft ihm eine Mannschaft für einen Synchronschwimm-Wettbewerb zu gründen.
The Twins go on a school camping trip and the Marsupilamis tag along, causing chaos. It's moulting season, and Twister's hairballs lead Stan to him!

SpongeBob möchte Muskeln haben, ohne zu trainieren, also bestellt er sich aufblasbare Arm-Attrappen, die alle beeindrucken, bis der Schwindel auffliegt, außerdem glauben SpongeBob und Patrick, dass sie Thaddäus mit einer Muschel umgebracht haben.

Perla bleibt keine andere Wahl, als mit SpongeBob zum Schulball zu gehen, aber dort angekommen, erweist er sich als hervorragender Tänzer. SpongeBob und Thaddäus kämpfen überdies eifrig um den Titel "Mitarbeiter des Monats".
pr.sub: Tanz' den Schwamm; Mitarbeiter des Monats

pr.d: Stan lures the Marsupilamis with the scent from his 100-year orchid, and manages to catch all three. Marcel steals Gran Gran's recipe book after tasting Jade and Mica's delicious sandwich.

Thaddäus Lieblingssendung wurde abgesetzt, und er beschließt, selbst eine Sendung zu drehen und SpongeBob wird beim Tanzen zufällig von einer Agentin entdeckt. Thaddäus ist neidisch auf SpongeBobs Erfolg und versucht, dessen Casting zu sabotieren.

Perla ist in der Krossen Krabbe und weint fürchterlich, weil ihre Begleitung für den Abschlussball abgesagt hat. Mr. Krabs sucht nach einem Begleiter für seine Tochter. Schließlich schlägt er SpongeBob vor. Doch Perla ist zunächst nicht begeistert.
Meteorite finds a nightclub in the forest. But it's a trap laid by Gargamel! Meteorite is going to have to save her friends.
Betrayed by Handy, Diaper Daddy is looking for a more loving family. Dwayne adopts him as a new toy.

Mr. Krabs Tochter erfährt einen Wachstumsschub und Mr. Krabs kommt kaum mit der Nahrungsmittelbeschaffung hinterher. SpongeBob bleibt in seiner Mangel stecken und seine Freunde versuchen mit allen Mitteln, ihn daraus zu befreien.
pr.sub: Der Wachstumsschub; In die Mangel genommen

pr.d: Dimwitty and Clumsy decide to get rid of the fire truck so that they no longer argue about it. But it is very difficult to put out a fire on foot. Gargamel leaves magic pebbles in the forest to hypnotise the Smurfs.
pr.sub: Fire Brigade on Foot; The Prettiest Pebble in the World

pr.d: Plankton landet per Zufall in Sandys Badezimmer und stiehlt ihren Pelz, um sich als Sandy auszugeben. Plankton soll in Mr. Krabs Kopf eindringen. Leider geht der Plan schief und Plankton landet stattdessen in SpongeBobs Kopf.
Theodore is passed over when Alvin and Eleanor train as lifeguards; Miss Croner's cherries are lost.

Als Plankton klar wird, dass Fett ein Geschmacksträger ist, bricht zwischen ihm und Mr. Krabs ein Wettstreit aus, wer das fettigste Mahl zubereitet. SpongeBob hört ein Telefonat von Mr. Krabs mit und glaubt zu hören, dass der ihn loswerden will.
pr.sub: Schmierige Schlacht; Ein Schwamm will nach oben

pr.d: The Munks help a world-famous runner design a pair of prosthetic legs for a race she's set to run in. Theodore embarks on a quest to find one thing he can do better than Simon, and he quickly realises it won't be easy.
pr.sub: Run Aimee Run; Theo vs. Simon

pr.d: Thaddäus wird wegen Umweltverschmutzung zu gemeinnütziger Arbeit verurteilt und dabei wird sein Ehrgeiz geweckt. SpongeBob möchte Gary mit einem Haustier eine Freude machen, doch der Spielkamerad entpuppt sich als mörderisches Untier.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: A backed-up Boss Baby is forced to take a sick day when his system stalls, and he can't go boom-boom, so it's up to Tim to take over.

pr.sub: The Best Day Ever; The Gift of Gum

pr.d: SpongeBob attempts and fails his driving test again, but a fed up Ms Puff wants him out of her classroom so she makes up extra credit for him so he can pass the test. SpongeBob tries to join an exclusive jellyfishing club.
pr.sub: No Free Rides; I'm Your Biggest Fanatic

pr.d: SpongeBob eats sea onion ice cream and his breath stinks. When people avoid him, Pat convinces him that it's because he's ugly. When Mr Krabs gives his daughter Pearl a job at the Krusty Krab, she starts to make some changes.
SpongeBob and Patrick tell all sorts of fibs to sell chocolate door to door. Mermaidman and Barnacle Boy are back once more.
Mr Krabs sends SpongeBob and Patrick to spy on Plankton. SpongeBob and Squidward star in an instructional boating video. Mr Krabs pits SpongeBob against Squidward.
pr.sub: Spy Buddies; Boat Smarts; Good Ol' Whathisname

pr.d: SpongeBob is determined to find out everything there is to know about Viking. Patrick persuades SpongeBob to ditch class, but fun soon turns to guilt.
SpongeBob can never say no to anyone, so he orders a product called the 'abrasive side'. SpongeBob gets a song stuck in his head.
Patrick and Octo must survive together in the forest after Octo twists all of his ankles. The adults sneak off to play a board game, but one of the campers is not easily shaken off.
As everyone prepares to leave Camp Coral, SpongeBob and Patrick stay behind so SpongeBob can catch his first jellyfish. This goes wrong when two criminals decide to use the camp as a hideout.
Perch Perkins, Bikini Bottom's leading journalist, leads a deep-dive retrospective into the secrets, scandals and successes of The Krabby Patty.
pr.sub: Beneath the Bun: Krabby Patty Secrets Special

pr.d: Plankton teams up with Man Ray to take over the Krusty Krab and then, the world. Squidward quits the Krusty Krab to work for Plankton, turning the Chum Bucket into an overnight success.

pr.d: When SpongeBob thinks he's allergic to his pineapple, Squidward offers to help find him a new home. Squidward is getting a nose job at the local hospital, and SpongeBob tags along as moral support.
The long-lost episode of Mermaid Man is finally showing on TV, but will SpongeBob make it home in time to watch? Karen gets a computer virus, and it's up to SpongeBob to get it out of her.
In order to avoid doing chores, Sandy invents a "Smart Cabin"; Squidward takes over as Camp Master.

pr.t: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai
pr.d: Every fall in the northern Pacific, up to a million salmon migrate back to the rivers and streams where they were born to spawn. Many of these streams are located in Katmai National Park, Alaska.

pr.t: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai
pr.d: The crew heads inland to a section of the river to observe the many different families as they fish. Along their path, they have an intimate encounter with a mum and her three cubs.

Summer in Yellowstone is a time of warmth and light; more than any other season, it brings an abundance of life to the park, from flowering plants and insects to hungry grizzly bears, curious coyotes and herds of elk.

Fall is a season of change in Yellowstone; the park bursts with vivid colours; some of its residents take advantage of the last few remaining lazy days of summer, while others prepare for the snowy season ahead, including finding a mate.

The jaguar is the third largest of the big cats, and pound for pound, the most powerful. This jaguar patrols a home range of over 100 square kilometres in Brazil, deep in the heart of the world's largest tropical rainforest.

Our film journey begins in Alaska's west. We are hoping to find glacier bears in the glacial regions of the Katmai National Park on the Douglas River. At the end of July, brown bears have now arrived to fish for salmon. In the surrounding forests, grizzlies look for berries and fresh, green twigs. The Katmai is Alaska's most volcanic area, and with 15 active volcanoes it is a veritable powder keg, surrounded by glaciers. In the Hook glacier region moose and lynx accompany us.

pr.t: Muddy Waters and the Rolling Stones: Live at the Checkerboard Lounge
pr.d: On 22 November 1981, in the middle of their mammoth American tour, the Rolling Stones arrived in Chicago prior to playing three nights at the Rosemont Horizon. Long influenced by the Chicago blues, the band went to Buddy Guy's club to see the legendary Muddy Waters perform. This unique occasion was captured on camera and has now been restored from the original footage.

His plans get turned upside down when he becomes the target of a mysterious operative who can seemingly predict his every move. To his horror, Brogan soon learns that the man who's trying to kill him is a younger, faster, cloned version of himself.

An LA record producer returns to his New Jersey hometown ten years after being rejected by his high-school cheerleader crush. Having made the transformation from no-hope geek to Greek god womaniser and with his friend still single, he embarks on a second seduction strategy that does not always go to plan.

Greg and Pam have been together for ten years, and now they're the proud parents of two adorable twins. However, money is tight and in order to keep his family afloat, devoted nurse Greg takes a second job working for a drug company. That development doesn't sit well with Jack, whose previous suspicions regarding his hapless son-in-law soon come back in full force after learning of this development.
Previews of the great films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky.

Two inseparable best friends navigate the last weeks of high school and are invited to a gigantic house party. Together with their nerdy friend, they spend a long day trying to score enough alcohol to supply the party and inebriate two girls in order to kick-start their sex lives before they go off to college. Their quest is complicated after one of them falls in with two inept cops who are determined to show him a good time.

Officers in Wales discover a car containing guns during a routine stop, and booze-fuelled brawls on Saturday night take the rapid response cops out of their cars and onto the streets.

Bob is a washed-up revolutionary who lives in a state of paranoia, surviving off-grid with his daughter, Willa. When his nemesis resurfaces and Willa goes missing, the former radical scrambles to find her while battling the consequences of his past.

Set to his most beloved songs is the epic musical story of Elton John, from his breakthrough years in the 1970s to his fantastical transformation from shy piano prodigy to international superstar and pop icon.

Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis, quickly christened 'Joker' by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant, and pudgy Private Lawrence, nicknamed 'Gomer Pyle', as they endure the rigours of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering, and eventually participating in, the Battle of Hue.

Concerned that his half-human grandson isn't showing his vampire side, Dracula decides to put his grandson through 'monster' boot camp. Then, Dracula's father unexpectedly pays a visit.

Mavis surprises Dracula with plans for a fun-filled summer voyage on a monster cruise. As the pack starts enjoying colossal buffets and exotic excursions, Drac finds himself falling for the ship's intriguing but dangerous captain. He soon learns that trying to balance family, friends and romance might just be too much to handle. Even for the world's most powerful vampire.

Mumble's son Erik hasn't yet found his talents, and he goes with his friends to Adélie-land which is ruled by a penguin who can fly. When Erik returns to Emperor-land and finds them trapped under big walls of ice. Will Erik be able to save his family and friends before it is too late?

A neurotic ant struggles to express his individuality in a colony of conformists. He attempts to break from his totalitarian society while at the same time trying to win the affection of the princess he loves.

War veteran John Rambo takes on the entire Vietnamese army, plus Soviet advisers, when he is released from prison and sent back to present-day Vietnam in search of American prisoners of war still being held in enemy custody.

Reluctant one-man army Rambo goes into action against brutal Soviet invaders in Afghanistan. Sought out in a Buddhist monastery retreat, Rambo declines his former commander's request for help to deliver missiles to the mujahideen, but when his superior is captured and imprisoned, the hulking hero brings out the big guns.
A CIA agent comes up against a duplicitous American government during his quest to nab a Colombian drug lord.
Sinbad sails to the island of Colossa to rescue a beautiful princess from an evil sorcerer's spell. Once there, he does battle with a succession of marvellous creatures.

A shy student becomes a crime fighter after a bite from a mutant spider, during a school outing, gives him extraordinary powers. As he comes to terms with his new-found abilities, he is also forced to contend with a maniac villain known as the Green Goblin.

When a failed nuclear fusion experiment results in an explosion that kills his wife, Dr. Otto Octavius is transformed into Dr. Octopus, a cyborg with deadly metal tentacles. Doc Ock blames Spider-Man for the accident and seeks revenge. Meanwhile, Spidey's alter ego, Peter Parker, faces fading powers and self-doubt. Complicating matters are his best friend's hatred for Spider-Man and his true love's sudden engagement to another man.

Life is sweet for Peter Parker, MJ loves him, her career is taking off and Spidey-mania is sweeping New York. However, when an alien parasite bonds to his suit, it's not long before the good times and Spidey turn bad. While his ugly ego is taking centre stage, MJ is dumped from her Broadway show, Harry remembers Spider-Man's role in his father's death, and Peter is consumed by revenge.
On his quest to unravel the mystery of his own past, teenage social outcast Peter gains spider-like superpowers, and must deal with both everyday school life and dangerous villains.
When a cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and drops it into the unknown, the Platt family soon discover that their survival depends on sticking together in an alien landscape.

A few weeks into their van life adventure, a young couple witnesses an accident that leaves the driver dead. Soon, they're being pursued by a demonic stalker who's impossible to outrun and follows them wherever they go.

After the loss of her husband, a grieving woman seeks solace with her in-laws at their secluded family home. However, it soon becomes a reunion from hell as the Book of the Dead unleashes demonic forces that transform them into Deadites one by one.
After Claire inherits her uncle's Christmas-themed bar, she must square off against a neighbouring competitor to save it from its drowning debt.

Bad dreams haunt 15-year-old Gwen as she receives calls from the black phone and sees disturbing visions of three boys being stalked at a winter camp. With help from her brother, she must now confront a killer who's grown even more powerful in death.

A deep space transporter crash-lands on a desolate planet circled by three suns. Among the survivors are pilot Carolyn Fry, mystic Abu 'Imam' al-Walid, cop William J Johns and convicted criminal Richard B Riddick, and their first thoughts are of survival and escape. Then Fry finds out that the planet suffers a total eclipse every 22 years, which is when the hibernating, flesh-eating inhabitants awake and hunt.
A disposable employee is sent on a human expedition to colonize the ice world Niflheim. After one iteration dies, a new body is regenerated with most of his memories intact.
Three ghosts give a greedy network executive a long-overdue attitude adjustment over the Christmas period. Based on the Charles Dickens classic, 'A Christmas Carol'.

When a CEO tries to close her hard-partying brother's branch, he and his chief technical officer must inspire their co-workers and host an epic office Christmas party in an effort to impress a potential client and save their jobs.

Two army buddies who have become entertainers travel to a Vermont ski resort for a well-earned rest. However, on arrival they find the resort, run by their old army commander, in need of a helping hand. There's only one answer, to put on a show.
As his life unravels around him just in time for Christmas, Bernard dusts off an antique jewellery box that happens to contain trapped genie Flora, who might just be able to help him.

A former black ops commando fakes his death for a quiet life in Boston. Finding himself face to face with Russian gangsters, he comes out of his retirement to rescue a young girl whose life hangs by a thread.

Robert McCall's mysterious past cuts especially close to home when thugs kill Susan Plummer, his best friend and former colleague. Now out for revenge, McCall must take on a crew of highly trained assassins, who will stop at nothing to destroy him.

Based on three hybridising narrative strands, three groups of villains are intent on retrieving a missing diamond. Turkish and Tommy team up with a pugilistic Irish gypsy named Mickey for the purpose of rigging unlicensed boxing matches. However, their opponent also arranges some dodgy betting with the courier of the stolen diamond, who subsequently goes missing. To complicate further, a New York gangster arrives on the scene.

A troubled female cop must unravel the perfect murder as she matches wits with two homicidal schoolboys, who believe they can't be caught after committing a motiveless crime. As she gets ever closer to the truth she at once alienates her new partner and puts her own life in peril.

Enchanted Emily Elizabeth and the Great Cliffini are having great fun being magicians, but then one magic trick makes Samantha's pet hermit crab disappear.
When Emily Elizabeth and her friends learn that Mr Morgan's travel buddy Ravi scaled a mountain and named it, they decide to do the same.

Tommy and Tallulah are having fun helping their friends but do not stop first to ask what their friends need. So Lopsiloo finds herself on the wrong side of the bridge, the wrong goods are served in Battersby's shop, and Pufferty's favourite ball gets thrown out when they tidy his kennel. The twins only realise the error of their ways when they take McCoggins's scooter away for cleaning.

When Madame au Lait is called away to give Chikidee her ping pong lesson, Tommy and Tallulah bake a massive sticky carroty cake on their own. Ignoring the recipe, they make so much mixture that the oven explodes when they try to cook it, showering the whole town with sticky gunk and bringing Pufferty to a standstill. The race is on to free him before Chime Time.
Practice stacking and balancing as the Tree of Wisdom cleans up plates after breakfast, grooves along to a salsa dance, and sings about classic Australian snacks.
It's dance competition time again to see if the Tree of Wisdom or the Little Tree will win, followed by a pirouette lesson and an out-of-this-world space adventure.
Join the trees for a 'splodge-tastic' arts and crafts adventure where they dance, groove, and paint colourful blobs everywhere to the sound of the Tree's catchphrase.
The singing contest returns to the treetop. Find out who wins between the Tree of Wisdom and the Little Tree before clapping and dancing along to this upbeat track.

pr.d: Help blow up balloons as the Tree of Wisdom prepares for a spectacular party while discovering the world of opera and enjoying a sing-along dedicated to Italy.
Stop to smell the beautiful garden flowers with the Tree of Wisdom, but watch out for allergies. Help fix a broken bell and sing about everyone's different preferences.
pr.sub: Some People Like Trees, Some People Like Trucks

pr.d: Wake up early for an energetic morning dance competition to see who takes home a shiny trophy, followed by a leaf-shaking performance of this classic sea shanty.
The grand finale of the series features a celebratory, rhythmic journey through Australia's most famous bush ballad, complete with sheep-herding dances and campfire sing-alongs.

Tommy and Tallulah offer to do the polishing so that Madame Au Lait can make their favourite fruity trifle. While she is out buying the ingredients, the twins go polish crazy, thinking that the more they use, the happier Madame Au Lait will be and the more trifle she will make. The clock house is gleaming when Madame Au Lait returns, but when she sets a hoof on the floor, she finds that it is as slippery as an ice rink.

The twins are asked to collect McCoggins' bell for a town performance, but Tommy and Tallulah manage to break it despite Battersby's warning that the clapper is fragile and does not have a spare. Deciding they must make a replacement, they look everywhere for something to use and try some very unusual options to get the bell ready for Chime Time.

Tommy and Tallulah agree to babysit the spring chicks while Madame Au Lait tends to Mother Chick's hurt wing, but the twins do not realise just how much of a handful they will be. The twins are also taking part in the town kite display, but, somehow, the chicks end up surfing on their kite, high in the sky, so they must stage an airborne rescue before Chime Time.

It is Christmas Eve, and the animals are all looking forward to their annual tradition of sliding down the snowy hill on Christmas morning. Everybody is busy preparing for the event, but they soon realise it risks being ruined as there is no snow to slide down, so the friends must figure out how to save their favourite Christmas tradition.
pr.sub: The Story of the Merry Jinglewhizz

pr.sub: The Story of Confuse-Us the Carp
